findings.summary: §2 criterion 2b is still non-discriminative. GT-16a/GT-16b now derive the bound from workflows/deep-research/tick/workflow.yaml limits.node_timeout (that half of the prior blocker is fixed), but the measured window still contains no work: the seed board is a single clue with status 'proposed', and DEFAULT_TICK_CONFIG.triageThreshold is 3, so decideTick returns zero decisions — no dispatch/spawn, no worker-result wait, no harvest, no triage ever runs. Every latency source the criterion names is therefore absent from `elapsed`, and reverting any timing fix leaves both tests green. The tests also still bypass the entry under test: they call runChannelWrite() with a stubbed global fetch and a mocked node:child_process rather than driving the real `--run` CLI on a seed board (test/fixtures/fake-bus.mjs plus the real tick-entry spawn pattern used by e0c2-termination.test.ts is available for exactly this).

The Y5 'reverse' case is a byte-for-byte duplicate of the forward Y5 case (same journal `[外部调用失败 status=TIMEOUT]`, same assertions res.code !== 0 / TICK FAILURE / run_dir / status=TIMEOUT). It constructs no reverse condition and adds no discriminative value beyond the forward case; its comment claims a red/green pairing the test does not implement.

`--max-clues` is only threaded into deps.harvest.maxClues; it is not merged into the tickConfig passed to decideTermination, which keeps DEFAULT_TICK_CONFIG.maxClues=64 for `capHit = count >= cfg.maxClues`. Under the regression profile (MAX_CLUES=24) the board can never reach 64 clues, so the `capped` terminal state becomes unreachable and criterion 6's non-null termination must come solely from the zero-growth path — a self-inconsistency between the declared narrowing and the termination judgment.

GT-17a injects a hand-copied re-implementation of the production readBody (poll → readGenerateResult → checkRunExited → throw GenerateWorkerExitedWithoutResultError) into generateDeps.spawnRuntime instead of driving assembleGenerateDeps. GT-14b now covers the production detection path, so this duplicated logic is redundant and will silently diverge if the production readBody changes.

`expect(result.timings!.busReadMs).toBeGreaterThan(0)` asserts a strictly positive millisecond delta on a path whose board read is an instantly-resolved stub; with 1 ms Date.now() resolution this is a latent flake against criterion 1's two-consecutive-green requirement. Asserting >= 0 (or asserting the field's presence) would be stable.

Correctly delivered and verified this round: the §1.3 drain checker now matches `[外部调用失败 status=<S>]` and names both run_dir and status (scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs:79-84) with a genuine driving test (Y5); MAX_CLUES=24 is declared by the regression profile and wired through deep-research-loop.sh → fleet.yaml.tpl → workflow.yaml → tick.md → `--max-clues` → RunWriteOptions.maxClues; phase-split `timings` instrumentation is restored on RunWriteOutcome; and GT-14b now drives the production assembleGenerateDeps readBody so the generate-side checkRunExited short-circuit is genuinely exercised.
